<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" id="Definitions_TicketBooking" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/ticket-booking">

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_TicketSearch" name="Ticket search request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RouteSelection" name="Route, date and time selected"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PersonalPaymentDetails" name="Personal and payment details provided"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_TicketDelivery" name="Ticket delivered"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_TravelReminder" name="Travel reminder and check-in instructions"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_JourneyCompleted" name="Journey completed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Feedback" name="Post-travel feedback"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_TicketBooking">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_TravelCompany" name="Travel Company" processRef="Process_TicketBooking"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SearchRequest" name="Search request" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_TicketSearch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RouteSelection" name="Route, date and time" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="ReceiveTask_RouteSelection"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Details" name="Personal and payment details" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="ReceiveTask_CustomerDetails"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TicketToCustomer" name="Ticket" sourceRef="SendTask_SendTicket" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReminderToCustomer" name="Reminder and instructions" sourceRef="SendTask_SendReminders" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_JourneyCompleted" name="Journey completed" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_JourneyCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" name="Feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_TicketBooking" name="Ticket Booking Process" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_TicketSearch" name="Ticket search received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_TicketSearch" messageRef="Msg_TicketSearch"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PresentOptions" name="Present flight, train and bus options"/>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_RouteSelection" name="Receive selected route, date and time" messageRef="Msg_RouteSelection"/>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_CustomerDetails" name="Receive personal and payment details" messageRef="Msg_PersonalPaymentDetails"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_GenerateTicket" name="Generate ticket"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendTicket" name="Send ticket via email or SMS" messageRef="Msg_TicketDelivery"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_UpdateInventory" name="Update seat inventory"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderSplit" name="Reminders requested?" default="Flow_NoReminder"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendReminders" name="Send reminders and check-in or boarding instructions" messageRef="Msg_TravelReminder"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderMerge" name="Reminder step merge"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_JourneyCompleted" name="Journey completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_JourneyCompleted" messageRef="Msg_JourneyCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" name="Feedback or follow-up service offered?" default="Flow_NoFeedback"/>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_Feedback" name="Receive post-travel feedback" messageRef="Msg_Feedback"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProcessConcluded" name="Process concluded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_TicketSearch" targetRef="Task_PresentOptions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_PresentOptions" targetRef="ReceiveTask_RouteSelection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_RouteSelection" targetRef="ReceiveTask_CustomerDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_CustomerDetails" targetRef="ServiceTask_GenerateTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="ServiceTask_GenerateTicket" targetRef="SendTask_SendTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="SendTask_SendTicket" targetRef="ServiceTask_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="ServiceTask_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReminderYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderSplit" targetRef="SendTask_SendReminders">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${reminderRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoReminder" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderSplit" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="SendTask_SendReminders" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_JourneyCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_JourneyCompleted" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Feedback">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${feedbackOffered}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoFeedback" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" targetRef="EndEvent_ProcessConcluded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_Feedback" targetRef="EndEvent_ProcessConcluded"/>

  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
